name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 6 visits over 68 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-01-01, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.75 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
